description: The staff chat commands: :help for an administrator, alerts (:ha, :ra), :roommute, :mute/:unmute, credits, badges, :tradeban, :teleport, :coords, :itemdebug, :talk, :packet, :setconfig, :reload, :resetpw, :dc, :ban/:unban, and what a moderator may not do

steps.name: CHAT
steps.note: Page 1 of every command, sorted by first alias

messages.name: ALERT
messages.body:
Commands ('<' and '>' are optional parameters):

:about/info - Information about the software powering this retro
:addcredits/givecredits [user] [credits] - Add credits to user
:afk/idle - Put your eyes to sleep
:ban/userban [user] [minutes] [reason] - Temporarily bans a given user
:bot [amount] - Creates a bot partay!
:checkbalance/balance [user] - Checks the credit amount for an user
:coords - Shows the coordinates in the room
:copyroom - Creates a copy of the room
:dc/disconnect [user] - Disconnects a given user
:deletebadge/removebadge [user] [badge] - Remove badge from user

Page 1 out of 4

messages.name: ALERT
messages.body:
Commands ('<' and '>' are optional parameters):

:packet - Tests a Habbo client-sided packet
:pickall - Allows the owner to pick up all furniture in a room
:reload [component] - Refresh the settings/items/texts
:removecredits/delcredits [user] [credits] - Remove credits from user
:resetpw [user] - Resets the player's account
:rgb/rainbow - - Cycles through the rainbow in your very own room!
:roomalert/ra - Sends an alert room-wide
:roommute/eventmute - Mutes/unmutes a room
:setconfig [setting] [value] - Allows to update server configs.
:shutdown - - Shutdown Havana
